upgrade: a store written by an older kb, refused, then migrated and used.

The store's index database is a frozen schema-v8 file (the newest version before the one in
this build) holding a few entries and seven logged searches (the last one ran with the feedback prior). kb refuses it and says what to run.
migrate up backs the file up first, and the search log survives the upgrade.

  $ kb init --model none
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model none)

  $ rm .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite

  $ mkfixture index-v8 .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite

  $ kb search checkpoint --mode fts
  [stderr] kb search: store database $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite is at schema v8; this kb needs v9. Run: kb migrate up (with the same --store, if any)
  [exit 1]

  $ kb doctor
  ok   config: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  ok   sources: 1 configured: "data" (entries)
  FAIL migrate: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite is at schema v8, this kb needs v9 (index/0009-tier-memory); run kb migrate up
  ok   model: none: FTS-only index and search
  ok   entries: 0 entries valid
  ok   index.md: absent (optional export)
  ~ ok   version: kb \(version\) at .*
  doctor: 1 failed, 0 warnings
  [stderr] kb doctor: 1 check(s) failed
  [exit 1]

kb version works on any file version, so it runs before the upgrade.

  $ kb version
  kb (version)

  $ kb migrate status
  SCOPE          FILE         VERSION   STATE                         PATH
  location       location     v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/kb.toml
  store default  config       v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  store default  index        v8 -> v9  1 pending: run kb migrate up  $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite
  cache          embed-cache  -         not created yet               $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache.sqlite

  store default index:
    index/0009-tier-memory  add fts_tier, memory_rank and memory_score to search_results and search_candidates
  [exit 1]

The dry run reports the steps and the backup it would write, and changes nothing: the status
still says v8 and no backup file exists.

  $ kb migrate up --dry-run
  would migrate store default index: v8 -> v9 ($WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite)
    backup would be written to $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-v8-(time)
    would apply index/0009-tier-memory: add fts_tier, memory_rank and memory_score to search_results and search_candidates

  $ kb migrate status
  SCOPE          FILE         VERSION   STATE                         PATH
  location       location     v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/kb.toml
  store default  config       v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  store default  index        v8 -> v9  1 pending: run kb migrate up  $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite
  cache          embed-cache  -         not created yet               $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache.sqlite

  store default index:
    index/0009-tier-memory  add fts_tier, memory_rank and memory_score to search_results and search_candidates
  [exit 1]

  $ ! exists .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-*

migrate up backs the file up and applies the step (this one clears nothing, so no reindex is
needed).

  $ kb migrate up
  migrated store default index: v8 -> v9 ($WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite)
    backup: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-v8-(time)
    applied index/0009-tier-memory: add fts_tier, memory_rank and memory_score to search_results and search_candidates

  $ exists .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-v8-*

  $ kb migrate verify
  ok   location kb.toml
  ok   store default config.toml
  ok   store default kb.sqlite

  $ kb migrate status
  SCOPE          FILE         VERSION  STATE            PATH
  location       location     v1       current          $WORK/proj/.kb/kb.toml
  store default  config       v1       current          $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  store default  index        v9       current          $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite
  cache          embed-cache  -        not created yet  $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache.sqlite

With many stores, --all covers every store of the location (and the global location); nothing is pending now.

  $ kb migrate up --all
  everything is up to date

The fixture's seven logged searches are still there: the new search is number 8, and the
overview counts all eight.

  $ kb search checkpoint --mode fts --caller claude
  search 8 · 1 hit
  [1] alpha.md › Body
  checkpoint starvation
  search_id=8
